# Third-party shaders and techniques

| File | Source | License |
|---|---|---|
| `pixelart_stylizer.gdshader` | Leo Peltola, [Godot-3d-pixelart-demo](https://github.com/leopeltola/Godot-3d-pixelart-demo) (3D pixel art outline & highlight shader), copied unmodified | MIT, see `LICENSE-pixelart_stylizer.txt` |
| `shaders/cel.gdshaderinc`, `shaders/grass.gdshader`, the sprite lighting at the base point, `assets/vendor/grass_atlas.png`, the subpixel camera in `scripts/ui/pixel_camera.gd` | Adapted from [Robert-K/godot-3d-pixel-art](https://github.com/Robert-K/godot-3d-pixel-art) (stepped cel shading, cloud shadows projected along the sun, billboard grass lit at its base and swaying in groups at a low frame rate, texel-snapped camera with subpixel display offset), itself inspired by t3ssel8r | MIT, see `LICENSE-godot-3d-pixel-art.txt` |
